en: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return true if it is possible to divide this array into k non-empty subsets whose sums are all equal.
examples:
Input: nums = [4,3,2,3,5,2,1], k = 4
Output: true
Explanation: It is possible to divide it into 4 subsets (5), (1, 4), (2,3), (2,3) with equal sums.
constraints: The frequency of each element is in the range [1, 4].
title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
